messages.author: 3908a2da5354fc44
messages.subject: details option in secr.fit
parts:
Murray,

Maybe I am using the option incorrectly, but when I try to use a "details" option in secr.fit I get an error message.

For example,

> bobcat2k.fit <- secr.fit(bobcat2k, buffer=3*RPSV(bobcat2k), details$centred = TRUE,)
Error: unexpected '=' in "bobcat2k.fit <- secr.fit(bobcat2k, buffer=3*RPSV(bobcat2k), details$centred ="


Or, if I use double equal signs I get:

> bobcat2k.fit <- secr.fit(bobcat2k, buffer=3*RPSV(bobcat2k), details$centred == TRUE)
Checking data 
Error in match(x, table, nomatch = 0L) : object 'details' not found

Any suggestions?

Thanks,

Duane

messages.author: 3908a2da5354fc44
messages.subject: Re: details option in secr.fit
parts: Never mind, I see that the format to use  is details = list(ignoreusage=TRUE). Sorry!
